window_method: centered secant; average seconds per quarter then invert; not mean of BPM
edge_policy: full windows only; no padding, truncation or extrapolation
limits: Raw DTW slope quantization is not measured rubato.
Window size trades time detail for reduced path quantization; it does not validate alignment.
Existing endpoint estimation and all alignment errors are inherited.
No trend is applied to note onsets, playback clock, or ribbons.
